items.title: HERMES: High-Performance Private Decoding for Large Language Models
items.snippet: Privacy-preserving inference (PI) enables users to query large language models (LLMs) without revealing their prompts, but incurs substantial computation and communication overhead. We present HERMES, a PI system optimized for LLM decoding. HERMES lowers time per output token (TPOT) by up to 2.7× and total PI latency by up to 2.1× on Llama 3.1 8B Instruct.

items.title: From Simulation to Reality: How UOS Robotics Won the RoboCup ARM Challenge 2026
items.snippet: UOS Robotics from the University of Seoul returned to the RoboCup ARM Challenge in 2026 after winning titles in 2022 and 2023. The team took first place in the global simulation round and went on to win the on-site final on home soil. Today’s blog highlights the engineering work behind this success: bringing perception, planning, and control algorithms from a virtual environment to a real Universal Robot.

items.title: Bright Security Introduces STAR Fuzzer, Agentic Fuzzing That Writes Its Own Harnesses and Proves Every Finding
items.snippet: Bright Security Introduces STAR Fuzzer, Agentic Fuzzing That Writes Its Own Harnesses and Proves Every Finding. Built on an evolutionary engine first released in 2018, STAR Fuzzer by Bright Security finds crashes, memory exhaustion and memory-safety bugs in security-critical code without a running application.

items.title: Self-host LiteLLM as your LLM gateway
items.snippet: LiteLLM is an open source LLM gateway you host yourself: one HTTP endpoint that all of your applications call, which then forwards each request to whichever provider should answer it. This enables features like virtual keys, per-key budgets, fallbacks, and pinned images, simplifying management and providing a single point for cost tracking.

items.title: Early Saxon Discursive Identity Revisited: Sensitivity Models and Hydro-Geographical Baselines
items.snippet: This supplement to the original article shifts the quantitative historiography of early Saxon ethnogenesis from purely discursive records to a hydro-geographical baseline. Spurred by a localized LLM tokenization anomaly in the gazetteer indexing the main study, a restored hybrid framework is subjected to dual sensitivity analyses.

items.title: Into the Unknown: Benchmarking AI agents on open scientific research problems
items.snippet: This paper introduces a new benchmark for evaluating AI agents on open scientific research problems, revealing that even leading models frequently fail to meet the specific conditions required by domain scientists or business constraints. The accompanying GitHub repository provides task materials, results, and evaluations under an Apache-2.0 license.

items.title: HexaShell: A Thin Harness for Exploring the Limits of VLM Agents as Robot Coding Agents
items.snippet: HexaShell proposes a thin harness that allows Vision Language Model (VLM) coding agents to control a two-arm robot, including writing and fixing tools based on observed failures. The study tests the capabilities of VLMs as robot coding agents within a RoboDojo experiment, achieving a 39.7 percent success rate for new configurations.

items.title: OpenMobile-2: Building Versatile Mobile Agents with Scalable Environments and App-Native Tools
items.snippet: OpenMobile-2 introduces a near-frontier mobile agent, complete with fully open training environments and recipes, including MobileGym++ which features 35 simulated commercial applications and hybrid GUI/app-native tool usage. This infrastructure helps in measuring errors by assessing the achieved application state rather than merely individual screen actions.

dropped.snippet: In the last few months, concerns have arisen about AI safety as a growing number of incidents were publicly disclosed.
